name: Velt
description: Add real-time collaboration to any React or Next.js app. AI-guided setup with codebase analysis, best-practice rules, and MCP-powered tooling for the Velt SDK. Includes commands for comments, presence, cursors, CRDT collaborative editing, and notifications.
longDescription:
Ships **12 skills**, **1 agent** and **2 MCP servers**.

- **Skills** (12): `add-comments` (Add collaborative commenting features (freestyle, popover, text, stream, page, editor-integrated) to your app), `add-crdt` (Add real-time collaborative editing using Velt CRDT with Tiptap, BlockNote, CodeMirror, or ReactFlow), `add-cursors` (Add live cursor tracking to show real-time cursor positions of other users), `add-notifications` (Add in-app notifications, email (SendGrid), and webhook integrations), `add-presence` (Add real-time user presence indicators showing who is active on a page), `install-velt` (Full guided installation of the Velt collaboration SDK into a React or Next.js project), `screenshot` (Capture a screenshot of the running application for visual reference or comment placement analysis), `velt-comments-best-practices` (Velt Comments implementation patterns and best practices for React, Next.js, and web applications), and 4 more
- **Agents** (1): `velt-expert` (Velt collaboration SDK expert for architecture, setup, and integration guidance)
- **MCP servers** (2): `velt-installer`, `velt-docs`

Installs with `claude plugin install velt@claude-community` from `velt-js/velt-plugin`.
